findings.claim: 2026-06-16 簽署併購 Anysphere（Cursor）合併協議，隱含股權價值 600 億美元，以 Class A 普通股支付；原預期 2026 年第三季完成。
findings.excerpt: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. (the “Company”), X67 Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company (“Merger Sub”), and Anysphere, Inc. (“Cursor”) entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger (the “Merger Agreement”)

findings.claim: 2026-08-14 Cursor 合併生效，共發行 389,289,254 股 Class A 普通股，隱含 Cursor 股權價值 600 億美元。
findings.excerpt: on August 14, 2026 (the “Effective Time”), the Merger became effective, and (i) the shares of Cursor’s common stock and the shares of Cursor’s preferred stock outstanding immediately prior to the Effective Time were automatically converted into the right to receive an aggregate of 389,289,254 shares of the Company’s Class A common stock
the Company issued $7.0 billion aggregate principal amount of its 5.350% Senior Notes due 2031 (the “2031 Notes”), $6.0 billion aggregate principal amount of its 5.650% Senior Notes due 2033

findings.claim: 公司章程要求股東爭議送德州商業法院，並以強制仲裁排除集體訴訟；未見已提起的證券集體訴訟。
findings.source: Bloomberg Law《SpaceX Maps Texas Strategy to Dodge Securities Class Actions》

note: FAA 調查搜尋結果僅見低可信度鏡像站，未採用。
